title: The half-period compact-circle element acts trivially on the complete spherical carrier

global_kernel.circle: C(alpha)=[exp(alpha e1e2),1] with alpha modulo 2 pi
global_kernel.half_period: z=C(pi)=[-1,1], the nontrivial global central spin element of order two
global_kernel.spherical_subgroup: M=Z_K(A) for the split Cartan A
global_kernel.membership: Because z is central in the connected spin group, z centralizes A and therefore z lies in M=Z_K(A).
global_kernel.homogeneous_action: On K/M, left translation gives z k M=k z M=k M for every k because z is central and z lies in M.
global_kernel.hilbert_action: The quasi-regular action on H_ps=L2(K/M) therefore satisfies U(pi)=I on the complete Hilbert carrier, not only on one K-type.

claim_ceiling: The repository-selected K1356 circle has a nontrivial order-two kernel on the entire spherical compact picture. This is a theorem about the internal homogeneous representation; it does not select the circle, identify hypercharge, or construct an action-derived physical quotient.
